body:
We fell in love with Scandinavian design for the principle at its core: something functional can also be beautiful. When function and beauty work in tandem, it creates a domino effect of wellbeing. Quality structure and practicality reduce stress and make life a little easier. Beautiful geometric lines and grounding wood accents makes your living spaces feel elevated and luxurious. Together, they create the sort of nursery you and your baby deserve – one that reliably supports your needs without compromising your impeccable style.

Because parenthood comes with plenty of compromises already, don’t you think?

The Domino Collection is our attempt to make sure you never have to compromise on the magic of form + function. Inspired by Nordic minimalism, The Domino 3-in-1 Convertible Crib and 3-Drawer Dresser’s striking geometric details and timeless natural wood accents pay tribute to Scandinavian design principles. Each piece is as functional as it is beautiful, with adjustable mattress heights to grow with baby, extra-deep drawers to hold every diaper, onesie, and toy, and baby-safe finishes that are built to withstand all the spills, bounces, and teething mishaps that come with those first few precious years. And when those first years have passed, our conversion kit will help you transform your Domino crib into a toddler or daybed for the years to come.

We hope The Domino Collection will have a domino effect of wellbeing in your home – that investing in beautiful, functional pieces will help you create memories full of good sleep, sweet dreams, and plenty of joy. We hope this collection helps you create a nursery that you and baby both love spending time in and that these pieces will grow and stay with your family long after the nursery years are gone.
